papers.title: Automatic Selection of Methods for Solving Stiff and Nonstiff Systems of Ordinary Differential Equations
papers.task_relation: Petzold develops a numerical integrator that changes methods according to stiffness to solve initial-value systems efficiently. This task implements the same numerical-solution objective for spatially discretized transport by convection and diffusion, with a local error-versus-evaluation-cost score and discretization.
papers.primary_goal: Improve the efficiency and reliability of solving stiff and nonstiff ordinary differential-equation initial-value systems.
